summary: Cass County tower erected 1928 as Fire Tower 52 in Foot Hills State Forest; listed as gone; sources disagree on its height and structure.

facts.design: Aermotor ladder tower (1928 record); a 1981 survey describes a steel truss tower
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source describes what remains at the site

corrections.why: 137N-31-7 is a legal land description for the site, not an agency. The county list gives the owner as Mn MFS, and its footnote names the Minnesota Forest Service.
The county list gives the owner as Mn MFS, the Minnesota Forest Service, which is a state agency.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1928 record gives 81 feet (24.7 m), which is kept here. A 1981 survey note describes about 100 feet and a steel truss structure. The county list does not say whether the tower was rebuilt.

sources.title: Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers: Cass County (PDF)

notes_for_editor: No staffing, fire history or removal date appears in any source read. The 1981 survey conflicts with the 1928 height and structure, and the list does not say whether the tower was rebuilt. The agency code 137N-31-7 in the record is a land description, so the agency and ownership corrections are proposed. The county list places the tower in the southern area of Foot Hills State Forest; state forest access rules were not checked.
